files.e1_held_prior.json: 297-view fit, factory distortion held, cx/cy 1 px prior; per-view RMS, solver diagnostics, cameras/extrinsics
files.e1_free5_prior.json: 297-view fit, all five distortion coefficients free, cx/cy 1 px prior
files.cfg_held_kc.json: model-selection config: distortion held + cx/cy prior; rig sigmas, pose absorption, identifiability, held-out split
files.cfg_free5.json: all five Brown-Conrady coefficients free (the live model)
files.cfg_*.npz: packed solution x, 39x39 marginal information, covariance diagonal and 39x39 rig block (compacted; full matrices were 45 MB each)
files.gate_fixed.json: observability gate output for held_kc / k1 / free5 recomputed with the corrected marginal information (the §1 table)
files.gate_cfg.json: the same gate with the shipped marginal-information construction (shows the 33/33, weak-focal numbers as the session produced them)
files.benchmark_backends.json: analytic LM vs SciPy finite-difference vs SciPy analytic Jacobian vs native calib_ref on the same 60-view problem
files.splithalf.json / splithalf_summary.json: 3 random halves (148 views each), refit, parameter spread vs predicted sigma
files.corner_counterfactual.json: Fisher-information effect of 48 synthetic corner/edge views on PP / k1 / k2 / fx
files.final/final_metrics.json: the chosen candidate: cull, refit, gate, held-out folds, epipolar, baseline, scale
files.final/validation.json: independent validation summary of the candidate

reproduce.fits: from /tmp/solver_work/common.py: load_observations() rebuilds calibrate.Observation objects from session.json; fit(...) calls calib.solvers.solve_joint
reproduce.gate: tools.wizard.observability.observability_gate(result, coverage, target='high', free_mask=<solver free mask minus cx/cy>)

notes: npz files are compacted to the rig block and diagonals; re-fit to regenerate full matrices
no file in the session candidate/ directory was written and no profile was activated

final_candidate.model: factory distortion HELD; principal point HARD-FIXED at the factory value (not optimised, no prior); fx,fy + right/tex extrinsics free
final_candidate.activation: never; no file written to the session candidate/ directory

principal_point.note: an earlier variant used the production 1 px prior and moved left.cx by -2.02 px; that was a soft-prior MAP estimate and is NOT the delivered candidate
